name: ai-ask
description: AI Ask — Hai Framework desktop workspace

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter ai-ask-contract build && pnpm --parallel --filter ai-ask-serv --filter ai-ask-desktop dev
scripts.dev:desktop: pnpm --filter ai-ask-contract build && pnpm --filter ai-ask-desktop dev
scripts.dev:serv: pnpm --filter ai-ask-contract build && pnpm --filter ai-ask-serv dev
scripts.lint: eslint scripts/*.mjs .github/scripts/*.{js,mjs} && pnpm -r --if-present lint && pnpm run lint:rust
scripts.lint:rust: cargo fmt --manifest-path apps/ai-ask-desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path apps/ai-ask-desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml -- -D warnings
scripts.test: pnpm --filter ai-ask-contract build && pnpm -r --if-present test && pnpm run test:rust
scripts.test:frontend: pnpm --filter ai-ask-contract build && pnpm --filter ai-ask-desktop test
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm --filter ai-ask-contract build && pnpm --filter ai-ask-serv build && pnpm --filter ai-ask-desktop test:e2e
scripts.tauri: pnpm --filter ai-ask-contract build && pnpm --filter ai-ask-desktop tauri
